Mail: M&T Bank, P.O. guest_pay.note: M&T loan payments are made after logging in to Online or Mobile Banking, by calling 1-877-686-8424, at a branch or by mail.

help.title: How to pay your M&T personal loan
paragraphs: Log in to M&T Online or Mobile Banking to set up one-time or recurring transfers from your M&T checking or savings account. You can also make a one-time payment from a checking or savings account at another bank. You can also call 1-877-686-8424 or visit any M&T branch.

By regular mail, send a monthly payment or payoff to M&T Bank, P.O. Box 64679, Baltimore, MD 21264-4679. For overnight delivery, use M&T Bank, 1800 Washington Blvd., 8th Floor, Box #64679, Baltimore, MD 21230.

help.title: Automatic Recurring Payments
paragraphs: Set up recurring transfers yourself in Online or Mobile Banking, call 1-877-686-8424 and a representative can set them up, or ask at a branch. You can also complete an authorization form so the right amount is paid on each due date; the form also lets you set up recurring principal-only payments.

help.title: Principal-only payments
paragraphs: One-time principal-only payments can only be made by mail. Complete the Principal-Only Payment form and mail it with your check to M&T RLS - Principal-Only Payments, P.O. Box 69719, Baltimore, MD 21264-9719.

help.title: Help with your User ID or password
paragraphs: You log in to Online Banking with your User ID and password. Forgot your User ID? On the login page choose Get Help with Your User ID and enter the primary email address or mobile number on your account to get a reminder by email or text. You can reset your password online in a few steps.
